arxiv-2106-02166.title: Gravitational Decoupling algorithm modifies the value of the conserved charges and thermodynamics properties in Lovelock Unique Vacuum theory.
arxiv-2106-02166.creator: Milko Estrada
arxiv-2106-02166.description: Abstract We provide an extension of the Gravitational Decoupling (algorithm) for the Lovelock theory with Unique Vacuum (LUV), which represents a simple way to solve the equations of motion. Due to the application of this algorithm, the energy of the system splits in the energy of the seed solution and the energy of each quasi-LUV sector .

arxiv-2205-02607.title: RF Interference in Lens-Based Massive MIMO Systems — An Application Note
arxiv-2205-02607.creator: Harsh Tataria
arxiv-2205-02607.description: Abstract We analyze the uplink radio frequency (RF) interference from a multiplicity of single-antenna user equipments transmitting to a cellular base station (BS) within the same time-frequency resource. The BS is assumed to operate with a lens antenna array, which induces additional focusing gain for the incoming signals.

arxiv-2207-06872.title: Data Augmentation for Low-Resource Quechua ASR Improvement
arxiv-2207-06872.creator: Rodolfo Zevallos, Nuria Bel, Guillermo Cámbara, Mireia Farrús, Jordi Luque
arxiv-2207-06872.description: Abstract Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is a key element in new services that helps users to interact with an automated system. Deep learning methods have made it possible to deploy systems with word error rates below 5% for ASR of English.

arxiv-2211-09304.title: Spectral conditions for k k -extendability and k k -factors of bipartite graphs This work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant Nos. 12271162 and 12011530064) and Natural Science Foundation of Shanghai (No. 22ZR1416300).

arxiv-2211-09304.description: Abstract Abstract Let G be a connected graph. If G contains a matching of size k , and every matching of size k is contained in a perfect matching of G , then G is said to be k -extendable . A k -regular spanning subgraph of G is called a k -factor .

arxiv-2309-12535.title: Superconductivity in Compositionally-Complex Cuprates with the YBa 2 Cu 3 O 7-x Structure
arxiv-2309-12535.creator: Aditya Raghavan, Nathan Arndt, Nayelie Morales-Colón, Eli Wennen, Megan Wolfe, Carolina Oliveira Gandin, Kade Nelson, Robert Nowak, Sam Dillon, Keon Sahebkar, Ryan F. Need
arxiv-2309-12535.description: Abstract High-temperature superconductivity is reported in a series of compositionally-complex cuprates with varying degrees of size and spin disorder. Three compositions of Y-site alloyed YBa 2 Cu 3 O 7-x , i.e., (5Y)BCO, were prepared using solid-state methods with different sets of rare earth ions on the Y-site.

arxiv-2312-17301.title: Explainability-Based Adversarial Attack on Graphs Through Edge Perturbation Thanks:
arxiv-2312-17301.creator: Dibaloke Chanda
arxiv-2312-17301.description: Abstract Despite the success of graph neural networks (GNNs) in various domains, they exhibit susceptibility to adversarial attacks. Understanding these vulnerabilities is crucial for developing robust and secure applications. In this paper, we investigate the impact of test time adversarial attacks through edge perturbations which involve both edge insertions and deletions.

arxiv-2410-18046.title: Floquet-Lindblad Master Equation Approach to Open Quantum System Dynamics
arxiv-2410-18046.creator: Fenton Clawson, Edward B. Flagg
arxiv-2410-18046.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fenton Clawson, Edward B. Flagg. A new solver, named FLiMESolve, is exhibited which is well suited for time-periodic (Floquet-type) Hamiltonians. This solver maintains the benefits of other solvers presently considered, while superceding their usefulness within its own regime. FLiMESolve is able to efficiently and accurately simulate time-periodic systems while being faster and more accurate than other solvers and with the ability to relax the secular approximation inherent to the Lindblad Equation.

arxiv-2601-01567.description: Abstract . In this article, we intend to study possible ( U ) (U) -embeddings of a Banach space X X into X ∗ ⁣ ∗ X^{**} . The canonical embedding of X X in X ∗ ⁣ ∗ X^{**} which possesses ( U ) (U) -embedding is of particular interest and such spaces are known as Hahn-Banach smooth spaces.

arxiv-2602-09230.title: Modeling Redshift Uncertainties in Roman Weak Lensing Cosmology
arxiv-2602-09230.creator: Olivier Doré
arxiv-2602-09230.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Olivier Doré. Cosmological constraints using weak gravitational lensing measurements from the Roman Space Telescope will require a powerful method for modelling uncertainties in the galaxy redshift distribution. In this work, we use an optimized version of the principal component analysis (PCA) to model uncertainties in the full shape of the redshift distributions, a method proposed by [ 9 ] and recently used in the Dark Energy Survey Y6 analysis.

pmc-11529472.description: Immune checkpoint blockade, which enhances the reactivity of T cells to eliminate cancer cells, has emerged as a potent strategy in cancer therapy. Besides T cells, natural killer (NK) cells also play an indispensable role in tumor surveillance and destruction.

pmc-12365169.creator: Jianxiong Chen, Jingtao Wang, Fan Li, Lin Zou
pmc-12365169.description: Ensuring airspace safety is crucial for the efficient operation of aviation, especially at high-altitude airports where challenging weather and geographic conditions significantly increase operational complexity. pmc-12660680.title: Unpredictable stress boosts perceptual learning and alters glucocorticoid and norepinephrine receptors in rats’ dorsal hippocampus
pmc-12660680.creator: Kairo A Albernaz-Mariano, Marília B Malta, Leticia M Bueno-de-Camargo, Erica de A Duque, Leonardo S Novaes, Guilherme Dragunas, João Lucas de-Sousa-Peres, Carolina D Munhoz
pmc-12660680.description: Cumulative stress is known for its detrimental effects, including anxiety and stress-related disorders. However, the potential positive or ‘hormetic’ outcomes of chronic unpredictable stress (CUS) remain vague. In our study using adult male Wistar rats subjected to a 14-day CUS model, we explored the implications of its cumulative effects.

pmc-13085400.title: De-2-hydroxyisobutyrylation of clusterin modulates neuropathology and memory deficits in an Alzheimer’s disease mouse model
pmc-13085400.creator: Xiaoping Peng, Chaoyue Ouyang, Fubin Ma, Yu Liu, Lv Luo, Jiawei Xing, Sifan Feng, Li Li, Jiahao Zhang, Jiaying Wang, Helei Cheng, Tianying Zhang, Feng Chen, Yan Wang, Lili Cui
pmc-13085400.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive, irreversible neurodegenerative disorder with no effective cure, posing a major clinical challenge. Lysine 2-hydroxyisobutyrylation (Khib) is a recently identified post-translational modification found across diverse species and is involved in key metabolic processes associated with the regulation of protein function. However, its role in AD remains poorly understood.

pmc-13091207.title: Ethylene glycol toxicity presenting as a rapidly deteriorating focal neurological exam and reversible cerebral herniation syndrome
pmc-13091207.creator: Andrea L Klein, Hayley H Rose-Inman, Paul E Stromberg, Allison N Seifert, Andrew B Moore
pmc-13091207.description: Ethylene glycol toxicity is an exceedingly rare toxic encephalopathy. Ethylene glycol is the primary toxin in antifreeze and exhibits its toxicologic effects via metabolites glycolic and oxalic acids, driving a profound metabolic acidemia. Classically, ethylene glycol toxicity presents as inebriation without focal neurological deficits.

Methods: We collected data on age, sex, origin area, presentation time, and diagnostic (macro)category in 510 adult patients.

pmc-13210880.description: .SignificanceThyroid cancer is the most common endocrine malignancy. Although fine needle aspiration (FNA) is the gold standard for diagnosis, 10% to 20% of FNAs yield indeterminate cytology, of which 20% to 30% prove malignant. Such diagnostic uncertainty drives repeat FNAs, costly molecular tests, and unnecessary surgeries, leading to increased healthcare costs, reduced quality of life, and emotional distress to patients.
